text: The reservoir-size section describes 'diminishing returns' with N. Which statement best captures the cost-performance tradeoff it gives?
choices: Doubling N halves the training cost, so always use the largest N possible
Performance keeps improving linearly forever, with no plateau
Larger N always overfits, so the smallest reservoir is optimal
Beyond N≈100–500 gains are small while the readout cost grows as N³, favoring moderate N
explanation: Section 8.5: capacity is bounded by N and doubling N roughly doubles it, but practical gains plateau by N≈100–500 while the O(N³) ridge solve makes doubling N cost ~8×. Going N=100→1000 costs ~1000× for <10% gain, so moderate N is favored.
